## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL; Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Moderate (Top 5 across 3 sectors); major divergence among large caps (AAPL/MSFT/META) tempers conviction.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy lead: XOM (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +12.28%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +7.36% | 1M: +10.28%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +6.52% | 1M: +9.30%) ABOVE TREND. Utilities strong: VST (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +4.06%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +9.46% | 1M: +1.98%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials firm: LMT (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND, HON (1W: +8.81% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: GOOGL (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +9.30%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: -4.87% | 1M: +2.04%) CORRECTION. Communication weak: TMUS (1W: -11.63% | 1M: -7.67%) BELOW TREND, CMCSA (1W: -9.05% | 1M: -2.55%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary suffering: TSLA (1W: -18.25% | 1M: -16.23%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: VST (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +4.06%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +9.46% | 1M: +1.98%) ABOVE TREND, HON (1W: +8.81% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +8.44% | 1M: -1.16%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Moderate (3 sectors in Top 5) — cyclical/utility tilt.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: META (1W: -8.79% | 1M: +7.81%) CORRECTION, CMCSA (1W: -9.05% | 1M: -2.55%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -9.12% | 1M: +2.29%) CORRECTION, ADBE (1W: -9.83% | 1M: +7.47%) CORRECTION, GOOGL (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in high-multiple Tech/Comm names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W movers: VST (1W: +10.76%), LMT (+10.72%), CEG (+9.46%), HON (+8.81%), FCX (+8.44%) — watch FCX RECOVERY vs 1M weakness. MAJOR divergence: multiple mega-caps (AAPL, MSFT, META) show 1W ≠ 1M — watch for trend breaks rather than broad conviction.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech is mixed-to-weak with headline CORRECTIONs and pockets ABOVE TREND: NVDA (1W: +0.66% | 1M: +4.36%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +9.30%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: -4.87% | 1M: +2.04%) CORRECTION; overall sector 1W performance is negative per summary.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials show select strength but overall soft 1W; JPM (1W: +1.97% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: -3.71% | 1M: +7.04%) CORRECTION, MA (1W: -3.85% | 1M: +8.83%) CORRECTION — breadth in Financials is mixed, so monitor for confirmation.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare mixed with defensive names holding: JNJ (1W: +3.72% | 1M: +8.44%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +0.04% | 1M: +3.50%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +1.43% | 1M: +7.12%) ABOVE TREND, but ISRG (1W: -17.48% | 1M: -17.65%) BELOW TREND is a notable outlier.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor cyclical/value exposure (Energy, Utilities, Industrials) such as XOM (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +12.28%) ABOVE TREND and LMT (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to large-cap Tech showing CORRECTION or BELOW TREND like GOOGL (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND and TSLA (1W: -18.25% | 1M: -16.23%) BELOW TREND; monitor major-cap divergence before increasing risk.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: XOM (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +12.28%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +7.74% | 1M: +3.82%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: GOOGL (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND, TSLA (1W: -18.25% | 1M: -16.23%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -11.60% | 1M: -4.17%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +4.06% | 1M: +12.15%, 10 stocks) and Utilities (1W: +2.71% | 1M: +2.43%, 10 stocks) for continued leadership. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -3.49% | 1M: -2.05%, 24 stocks) and Communication (1W: -4.40% | 1M: -3.77%, 10 stocks) remain at risk.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA (1W: +0.66% | 1M: +4.36%) hold recent weekly lows for tech stability; a sustained break below those weekly lows would signal broader Tech pressure. Monitor XOM (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +12.28%) continuation above recent highs for Energy confirmation. Watch GOOGL (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%) failing near-term support as a sign of expanding weakness.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
NOW (+55): ServiceNow headline on $1B cybersecurity tailwind; price BELOW TREND (1W: -11.60% | 1M: -4.17%) — sentiment diverging from price, watch for follow-through. BA (+50): Boeing news; price BELOW TREND (1W: -2.38% | 1M: -3.45%) — bullish headline but price not confirming. ACN (+80) was top bullish in feeds but price data not in this extract for confirmation.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
GOOGL (-50): EU antitrust fine headline and price BELOW TREND (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%) — sentiment confirmed by price. JPM (-45): negative headlines on reputational issues but price ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.97% | 1M: +5.19%) — sentiment diverging from price and worth monitoring for flow shifts.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL; Value/Cyclical style given Energy/Utilities/Industrials leadership. XOM (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +12.28%) ABOVE TREND and LMT (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength while large-cap Tech (GOOGL, AAPL, MSFT, META) are in CORRECTION or BELOW TREND. Major divergence among mega-caps and mixed news sentiment (GOOGL confirmed negative, NOW/BA bullish but price weak) is the key risk — watch for trend confirmation before reallocating core exposures.
